title: "Aney Synodeias": The poetry of Nikiforos Blemenos becomes a song through the music of Giorgos Fanourakis
excerpt:
Yiorgos Fanourakis' music moves between the lyrical and the contemporary, incorporating experimentations that converse with modal and traditional music.

At the heart of the album's aesthetics is the thistle, the plant that adorns and the poetic collection. For the album cover, it is depicted through a design inspired by Minoan Crete, referring to the common origin of the two creators from Heraklion.
